name: Owls
overview: Scripture identifies owls among various birds considered unclean, as seen in Leviticus 11 and Deuteronomy 14, where different kinds of owls are listed alongside other forbidden creatures. These birds are also used metaphorically to express desolation and loneliness, such as in Job 30:29 and Psalm 102:6, where the owl symbolizes a solitary figure in the wilderness or desert. The biblical portrayal of owls thus reflects both their physical distinctiveness and their spiritual symbolism of isolation and judgment.
